vision.name: Vegito's Spirit Sword
vision.text:
(If this card is revealed from your hand, search your discard pile for a card and Rejuvenate it.)
[Attack] 2: Physical attack.
You may discard a card from your hand to draw a card.
DAMAGE: 6 life cards.
HIT: Your next energy attack this combat is Unstoppable.
(Banish after use.)
vision.review: printed oddity: card type reads Energy Combat but the attack line says 'Physical attack'
vision.note: grey card; possessive title -> Named; stage cost printed as '2:'; no Endurance badge
